query: What is the current status of the 2026 Tour de France as of 13 July 2026? Latest general classification standings, has Tadej Pogačar retained the yellow jersey, any crashes or abandonments, current gap to Vingegaard.
answer:
I've completed my research on the 2026 Tour de France status. Here's a summary of the key findings:

**Yellow Jersey:** Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) has retained the yellow jersey. He briefly lost it early (Træen led after stage 4) but reclaimed it on the Pyrenean stage 6.

**Gap to Vingegaard:** Pogačar leads Jonas Vingegaard by **3:36**, with Evenepoel third at +4:06.

**Crashes/Abandonments:** 10 riders had left the race, including 3 concussion cases (Berthet, Molenaar, Træen). Chris Harper was the latest withdrawal (thumb surgery after a Puy Mary descent crash on stage 10). 174 of 184 starters remained.

One caveat I flagged: available reporting reflects standings after stages 10–11. The "as of 13 July" window corresponds roughly to this period given the 4 July start plus rest day. The confirmed facts — Pogačar in yellow, the 3:36 gap, and 10 abandonments — are well-sourced across Cyclingnews, ProCyclingUK, CyclingUpToDate, and Al Jazeera.

key_facts: Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) holds the yellow jersey; he reclaimed it on stage 6 over the Aspin/Tourmalet after Torstein Træen led after stage 4.
Pogačar leads Jonas Vingegaard (Visma-Lease a Bike) by 3:36 in the general classification.
Remco Evenepoel (Red Bull-BORA-hansgrohe) is 3rd at +4:06; Juan Ayuso 4th at +4:22; Paul Seixas 5th at +4:35.
Pogačar's cumulative GC time was 39:25:08 after the latest completed stage in the reporting window.
10 riders had abandoned the 2026 Tour by stage 11; 174 of 184 starters remained before stage 12.
Three of the abandoning riders suffered concussions (Berthet, Molenaar, Træen), prompting scrutiny of roadside concussion checks.
Chris Harper (Pinarello-Q36.5) was the latest withdrawal (stage 11 DNS) after a serious thumb injury from a stage 10 crash on the Puy Mary descent requiring surgery.
Tom Pidcock and Chris Harper both crashed on the Puy Mary descent during stage 10; Matteo Jorgenson was also a stage 10 crash victim.
Green jersey led by Mads Pedersen (Lidl-Trek) with 317 points; Pogačar leads KOM/polka-dot with 42 points; Juan Ayuso leads white/young rider; Lidl-Trek leads team classification.
The 2026 Tour de France is the 113th edition, running 4–26 July 2026, starting in Barcelona, organized by ASO, with 184 starters from 23 teams.
